author: The Critical Drinker
description:
Is the MCU saved? Are superhero movies totally back, baby? Join me for my review of Spider-Man: Brand New Day as we find out. 

Critical Drinker film premiere and fan meetup, London, September 10th. Get your tickets here: https://www.tickettailor.com/events/gradualupgradeproductions/2331646
title: Spider-Man - Marvel's Brand New Day?
